steps.criteria: ["npm install executes with exit code 0", "node_modules/astro exists", "node_modules/typescript exists", "node_modules/@astrojs/tailwind exists", "package-lock.json exists"]

steps.obj: Create base project directories and starter index page
steps.criteria: ["src/layouts/, src/pages/, src/components/, src/content/, src/styles/ directories exist", "src/pages/index.astro exists with basic HTML structure and 'News Website' title", "src/styles/global.css exists with @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;", "src/env.d.ts exists with /// <reference types=\"astro/client\" />"]

steps.obj: Create content collections configuration and sample content
steps.criteria: ["src/content/config.ts exists with defineCollection for 'articles' and 'categories' using z schemas", "src/content/articles/ contains at least 3 .mdx files with frontmatter matching schema", "src/content/categories/ contains at least 3 .mdx files with frontmatter matching schema", "Each article frontmatter includes: title, description, pubDate (ISO string), heroImage (string), category (string), tags (string[])"]

steps.obj: Build base layout components (BaseLayout, Header, Footer)
steps.criteria: ["src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro exists with DOCTYPE, html, head (meta charset, viewport, title, description), body with Header, slot, Footer, imports ../styles/global.css", "src/components/Header.astro exists with <header>, site title link to '/', nav with links to '/', '/about', '/contact'", "src/components/Footer.astro exists with <footer>, copyright notice, social placeholder links", "All components use TypeScript interfaces for props where applicable"]

["src/layouts/ArticleLayout.astro exists, extends BaseLayout pattern, accepts title, description, pubDate, heroImage, category props, renders article header with meta", "src/components/ArticleCard.astro exists, accepts title, description, pubDate, heroImage, slug, category props, renders card with link to article", "Both components have proper TypeScript prop interfaces"]

steps.obj: Implement home page, article detail page, and category page
steps.criteria: ["src/pages/index.astro imports getCollection, queries articles sorted by pubDate desc, renders ArticleCard grid (responsive: 1 col mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop)", "src/pages/article/[slug].astro exports getStaticPaths from getCollection('articles'), renders ArticleLayout with <Content /> for body", "src/pages/category/[slug].astro exports getStaticPaths from getCollection('categories'), filters articles by category, renders ArticleCard grid", "All pages import and use Header, Footer components"]

steps.obj: Create about, contact pages and RSS feed generator
steps.criteria: ["src/pages/about.astro exists with BaseLayout, describes the news site", "src/pages/contact.astro exists with BaseLayout, contact form (mailto link)", "src/pages/rss.xml.js exists, exports GET function, uses getCollection('articles'), generates RSS 2.0 with title, link, description, items (title, link, pubDate, description, content)", "RSS feed includes absolute URLs using site config"]

steps.obj: Build project and verify preview server starts
steps.criteria: ["npm run build executes with exit code 0", "dist/ directory exists with index.html, article/*, category/*, rss.xml, assets/", "npm run preview starts and binds to port (verified by process output containing 'Local' or 'Network' URL)", "No TypeScript errors in build output"]
